test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an INCORRECT preposition.

Please remember to take / your notice to the reception area / if you want it to be displayed / upon the bulletin board.

options.text: your notice to the reception area
if you want it to be displayed

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the preposition "**upon**" in place of "**on**."
 
• The preposition **"on"** is more commonly used and appropriate when referring to something being displayed on a surface like a bulletin board.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**on the bulletin board**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

**Correct Sentence:** ***"Please remember to take your notice to the reception area if you want it to be displayed on the bulletin board__."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "Please remember to take"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "your notice to the reception area"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "if you want it to be displayed"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in part 3.
